:bar_chart: *Alchemy (account-360 + pipeline) Test Coverage Audit — last 72h*

Summary: 2 PRs merged touching account-360/pipeline — 1 with full coverage, 1 with gaps

*:red_circle: Gaps (priority)*
• [Medium] feat(pipeline): New Sale badge/filter includes Prospect-account opportunities (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113>) — `apps/gtm/pipeline/api/src/routes/pipeline/deals-reads.ts` — *gtm-pipeline*: the New_Sale branch now ORs in an FGA-scoped `resolveAccountIdsByFacet(authUser,'status',['Prospect'])` id list, but all 7 new live cases stub OpenFGA as full-access (`allowed:true, all:true`). No restricted-persona case proves a Prospect account the caller *can't* read stays out of the bucket, and the empty-`prospectAccountIds` branch is never exercised — the same file already has `allowed:false` cases to copy.
• [Medium] <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> — `apps/gtm/pipeline/web/src/features/pipeline/PipelineView.tsx` / `web/src/render-smoke.test.tsx` — *gtm-pipeline*: the actual user flow (click the "New Sale" filter chip → a Prospect-account Renewal card appears showing the New Sale badge) has zero coverage. The three pipeline web test files in this PR got only a one-line `accountStatus: null` fixture field; badge logic is tested only in `libs/ui` via `renderToStaticMarkup`, and the filter only at the API level — nothing joins them. E2E-shaped, and `gtm-pipeline` has no `e2e/*.spec.ts` today (confirmed — only api-auth, fga-scoped, guardian-oauth, persona-login-ui, and 4 rnd specs) → route to render-smoke/component level.
• [Low] <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> — `apps/gtm/pipeline/api/src/routes/pipeline/deals.helpers.ts` — *gtm-pipeline*: `fetchAccountFieldsByIds`'s new `status` return-cast field and `fetchEnrichedOpps`'s `accountStatus` mapping have no test at their own level; covered only indirectly by one route-level assertion in `deals-reads.live.test.ts`.
• [Low] <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> — `apps/gtm/pipeline/api/smoke.json` — *gtm-pipeline*: `GET /pipeline` and `/pipeline/stats` changed behavior for `type=New_Sale` (extra account lookup + `inArray`), but the only probes are the bare paths — no probe covers that distinct query, which AGENTS.md asks for per distinct GET.
• [Low] <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> — `apps/gtm/account-360/libs/data-pipeline/src/pipeline.ts` — *gtm-account-360*: the shared `enrichedOppRowSchema` gained a required-nullable `accountStatus`, widening account-360's derived `PipelineRow`; its colocated `pipeline.test.tsx` was untouched. Risk is type-only — account-360 web renders no DealCard or recordType badge (grep-confirmed), so there's no behavior surface to assert.
• [Low] <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> — `apps/gtm/pipeline/web/src/features/pipeline/DealDetailPanel.tsx` — *gtm-pipeline*: the Kanban card now reads "New Sale" for a Prospect-account Renewal while the panel's "Record Type" field still renders the raw `Renewal`. Plausibly intentional (it's the literal SFDC field), but no test pins that divergence.

*:warning: Stale coverage risk*
• `apps/gtm/pipeline/api/src/routes/pipeline/deals.helpers.ts` changed in <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> — tests `deals.helpers.live.test.ts` (covers `fetchEnrichedOpps`) and `deals.helpers.test.ts` last updated in: not found (shallow checkout — file history unresolvable locally). Likely cause: the author asserted the new field one level up, at the route, in `deals-reads.live.test.ts` and skipped the helper's own suites.

• `libs/contracts/pipeline/src/pipeline.ts` changed in <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> (in scope — shared lib changed alongside pipeline code) — test `libs/contracts/pipeline/src/pipeline.test.ts` last updated in: not found (shallow checkout). That suite has accept/reject cases for the sibling row schemas but none pinning that `enrichedOppRowSchema` now *rejects* a row omitting `accountStatus` — it's nullable, not optional, so every producer must emit it.

*:white_check_mark: Coverage added*
• <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> — live (`apps/gtm/pipeline/api/.../deals-reads.live.test.ts`) — Prospect-account Renewal *and* Expansion bucket into `type=New_Sale`; Active-account Renewal stays out; account-less opp no-ops without erroring; explicit `type=Renewal` still returns both; the row itself carries `accountStatus: 'Prospect'`; `/pipeline/stats` byStage agrees with the list route.
• <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> — unit (`libs/ui/src/components/sales/DealCard.test.tsx`) — badge *color and text* for the Prospect short-circuit, plus non-regression for Active-account Renewal, unlisted `Amendment` (keeps its own text, blue), and null recordType.
• <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1114|#1114> — live (`apps/gtm/account-360/api/.../insights.search.live.test.ts`) — *gtm-account-360*: Gong fixture dates recomputed relative to `Date.now()`, so the `/gong/:id` rolling 90-day-window assertion no longer time-bombs (fixed a 5×-reproduced CI failure). Reliability fix — no new behavior covered, no source change in the PR.

Alchemy (account-360) test gap fill — 2026-09-21  Source report: <https://getdutchie.slack.com/archives/C0C0TFZNUR2/p1789988781959989> (+ continuation <https://getdutchie.slack.com/archives/C0C0TFZNUR2/p1789988781986509>)  <!subteam^S021R2MD7QQ> — new gaps needing a human below  This cycle's report ("Alchemy (account-360 + pipeline) Test Coverage Audit — last 72h", PR #1113 + #1114) had 6 gap bullets + 2 stale-coverage-risk bullets. After the scope gate, 0 were actionable for this account-360-only pilot:  *PRs opened:* None this cycle.  *Needs a human — other (e2e-out-of-scope / unclear / out-of-scope-for-pilot):* - 5 gap bullets + 1 stale-coverage-risk bullet, all under `apps/gtm/pipeline/*` (PR #1113: `deals-reads.ts` OpenFGA-stub gap, `PipelineView.tsx` e2e-shaped filter-chip flow, `deals.helpers.ts` gap+stale, `smoke.json` missing New_Sale probe, `DealDetailPanel.tsx` unpinned Record-Type divergence) — unclear, out of scope for the account-360-only pilot — first seen 2026-09-21. - `libs/contracts/pipeline/src/pipeline.ts` stale-coverage-risk (PR #1113) — unclear. The report tags this "in scope" for its own wider account-360+pipeline detector scope, but I verified via `gh pr view 1113 --json files` that PR #1113 does NOT touch any `apps/gtm/account-360/*` file, so it fails this pilot's own libs/* carve-out rule (same   source PR must also touch an account-360 file) — first seen 2026-09-21.  *Already covered (report was stale):* - `apps/gtm/account-360/libs/data-pipeline/src/pipeline.ts` (PR #1113 gap bullet, Low) — inspected: this file is genuinely under apps/gtm/account-360/*, but it wasn't edited by #1113 itself (last real edit was PR #1012, confirmed via `git log`) — it only picked up a wider derived type transitively from the shared `enrichedOppRowSchema`. Grep-confirmed account-360 web renders no DealCard or recordType badge, so per the report's own admission there is no behavior surface to assert — no closeable test exists here, treated as already-covered rather than forced into a vacuous test.  *Note on drift:* the detector's report scope has visibly widened since this pilot was authored — it now covers "account-360 + pipeline" jointly (Sept 18 and Sept 21 reports both), not account-360 alone. This agent continues to enforce the original account-360-only scope gate per its own instructions regardless of the detector's wider net.  Hard Gate checks (push access to GetDutchie/alchemy, write access to GetDutchie/skipped-test-reports) were both re-verified live this run via real push-and-delete probe branches — both fully working.

Alchemy (account-360) test gap fill — 2026-09-22  Quiet cycle: no account-360/pipeline PRs merged since the last audit (today's test-coverage-audit-account-360 run found 11 merged PRs in its 24h window, none touching apps/gtm/account-360/* or apps/gtm/pipeline/*). Nothing to fill this cycle.

:bar_chart: *Alchemy (account-360 + pipeline) Test Coverage Audit — last 24h*

Summary: 1 PR merged touching account-360/pipeline — 0 with full coverage, 1 with gaps (an unusually well-tested PR: 5 test files added/updated, 30+ new cases; gaps below are narrow residuals, not missing coverage). No PRs touched `apps/gtm/pipeline/**` in this window. Confirmed still true: `e2e/` holds only `api-auth`, `fga-scoped`, `guardian-oauth`, `persona-login-ui` and `rnd-*` specs — *neither* `gtm-account-360` nor `gtm-pipeline` has an e2e spec, so e2e-shaped gaps below have nowhere to run today.

*:red_circle: Gaps (priority)*
- [High] PF-9718: cog-based column ordering with durable user preferences (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/875>) — `apps/gtm/account-360/api/src/routes/preferences.ts` — account-360: new GET + PUT write path, but `requireRolePermission(c, 'account360.read')` has *zero* negative test — no 403 assertion in `preferences.test.ts` (only `admin`/`viewer`, both permitted), none in `preferences.live.test.ts`, and the two new `smoke.json` probes are a 200 GET and a 400 PUT, not the weaker-persona 403 the manifest convention requires for a mutation.
- [Medium] PF-9718 (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/875>) — `apps/gtm/account-360/web/src/features/account360/AccountListView.tsx` — account-360: the new `mode === 'table' && !isMobile` gate on `ColumnOrderWidget` is untested; `AccountListView.test.tsx` has 0 references to `isMobile`/`matchMedia`, so the cog leaking into board/spatial/mobile modes (or vanishing from table mode) would not fail a test.
- [Medium] PF-9718 (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/875>) — `libs/ui/src/components/data-display/ColumnOrderWidget.tsx` — account-360 (shared lib changed in the same PR, so same test bar): the `handleDragEnd` → `onColumnOrderChange` wiring is never exercised — all 7 widget tests pass `onColumnOrderChange={vi.fn()}` and only `onReset` is asserted called. Only the pure `reorderColumnOrder` helper is tested directly.
- [Medium] PF-9718 (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/875>) — `apps/gtm/account-360/web/src/features/account360/useAccountTableColumnOrder.ts` — account-360: the full round trip (drag → PUT → reload → order restored from server) is covered only in disconnected pieces — the hook's 9 unit tests mock `apiFetch`/`mutateApi`, and `preferences.live.test.ts` calls the route directly. Nothing crosses the browser:left_right_arrow:API boundary. This is e2e-shaped and account-360 has no e2e suite, so route it to a unit/live pairing or a new spec rather than to Playwright.
- [Medium] PF-9718 (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/875>) — `apps/gtm/account-360/web/src/features/account360/AccountEnhancedTable.tsx` — account-360: this table ships `columnOrder` alongside `enableColumnResizing` + `columnSizingStorageKey="alchemy:a360:list:colsizing:v1"`, but no test reorders columns with *pre-seeded persisted widths* — i.e. the returning user who already resized, then reorders. `DataTable.test.tsx`'s 3 new `columnOrder` cases use no resizing at all.
- [Low] PF-9718 (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/875>) — `libs/identity/src/schema.ts` + `drizzle/fleet/0011_flimsy_blockbuster.sql` — account-360 (sole consumer of the new `principal_preferences` table): the `ON DELETE cascade` FK to `principals` is never proven — `preferences.live.test.ts` deletes both tables explicitly in `beforeAll`/`afterAll`, so a broken cascade would leave orphan rows silently.
- [Low] PF-9718 (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/875>) — `libs/ui/src/components/data-display/DataTable.tsx` — affects *neither* app directly (account-360 flattens its family tree in `AccountListView` and passes no `groupBy`), but the new prop's own doc comment warns that `groupBy` + `columnOrder` breaks tree indenting unless the label column stays at index 0 — a documented hazard with no test, now live for ~25 other `DataTable` consumers.

*:warning: Stale coverage risk*

- `apps/gtm/account-360/api/src/index.ts` changed in <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/875> (mounts `preferencesRoute` at `/api/account-preferences`) — test `apps/gtm/account-360/api/src/index.test.ts` — not found (nearest colocated specs are `bootstrap.test.ts` / `cache.test.ts`, neither touched). The mount is proven only by the new `smoke.json` probes; the comment explains the prefix must not collide with mission-control's `/api/preferences`, and nothing asserts that.
- `libs/identity/src/schema.ts` changed in <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/875> — test `libs/identity/src/schema.test.ts` — not found (this lib's specs are `audit`, `guardian-vault`, `mount-product-auth`, `guardian-sub-backfill-migration`; none touched). A fleet-wide table now has its only behavioral coverage inside one app's live suite.
- `apps/gtm/account-360/web/src/features/account360/AccountListView.tsx` changed in <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/875> — test `apps/gtm/account-360/web/src/render-smoke.test.tsx` — not updated in that PR. The view gained a new affordance and a new network dependency (`GET /api/account-preferences/account-table-columns`); render-smoke's generic `jsonFetchStub()` returns a shape the hook reads as "no saved value", so the new path is entered but nothing about it is asserted.
- Caveat on this section: the audit checkout is a single squashed commit, so per-file "last updated in <earlier PR>" history is not resolvable here — entries above report whether the test exists and whether it was touched in #875, not its prior PR.

*:white_check_mark: Coverage added*
- <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/875> — unit (API) — `preferences.test.ts` (new, 6 cases): GET returns `null` for an unsaved preference, returns the saved value for the canonical principal, discards a stale/corrupt stored value (`version: 99`) instead of shipping it to the client, lets a read-only `viewer` save their own personalization, rejects a malformed `order` with 400 *before* any DB call, and 404s when `authUser.sub` resolves to no principal.
- <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/875> — live (DB-integration) — `preferences.live.test.ts` (new, 3 cases): real-Postgres compound-PK `onConflictDoUpdate` upsert (asserts exactly one row survives and `updatedAt` strictly advances), and canonical principal resolution for both dev-persona (`principals.id`) and Guardian (`principals.guardian_sub`) sessions — proving one human never gets two preference rows across auth engines.
- <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/875> — unit (web) — `useAccountTableColumnOrder.test.ts` (new, 9 cases): local-cache-first paint then server hydration, optimistic persist, fail-open on a failed write with offline retry-before-read, serialized rapid writes so a stale drag can't land last, a slow GET not clobbering an in-flight drag, and per-user localStorage isolation. Plus `AccountEnhancedTable.helpers.test.ts` (new, 6 cases on the reorderable-column set and `buildEffectiveColumnOrder`), 4 new `AccountEnhancedTable.test.tsx` cases asserting real header order (incl. `relevanceScore` first while searching and `_action`/`__filler` pinned to the tail), and 2 new `AccountListView.test.tsx` cases for the cog trigger and its populated dialog.
- <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/875> — unit (shared libs, in-scope via the same PR) — `useColumnOrderStorage.test.ts` (new, 10 cases: corrupt JSON, non-array, stale/unknown ids dropped, duplicate ids deduped, new columns appended, sanitize-on-write), `ColumnOrderWidget.test.tsx` (new, 7 cases), 3 new `DataTable.test.tsx` cases for the controlled `columnOrder` prop incl. the omitted-ids-append semantics and the unchanged default, and 1 new `libs/web-core/src/fetch.test.ts` case for `mutateApi`'s newly-allowed `PUT`.
- Note: `accounts.live.test.ts` was also touched in #875, but as a de-flake only (test-fixture prefix rename `itest-nullrollup-` → `itest-nrpsolo-` plus extra cleanup `DELETE`s) — no new behavior covered.

Alchemy (account-360) test gap fill — 2026-09-23  Source report: <https://getdutchie.slack.com/archives/C0C0TFZNUR2/p1790161605857969> (+ continuation <https://getdutchie.slack.com/archives/C0C0TFZNUR2/p1790161605908589>)  <!subteam^S021R2MD7QQ> — new PRs and/or gaps needing a human below  *PRs opened (7, all against `develop`, all test-file-only):* - <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1147> — `apps/gtm/account-360/api/src/routes/preferences.ts` (403 negative RBAC test) — dutchie-reviewer label: ship-show - <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1148> — `AccountListView.tsx` (ColumnOrderWidget mobile gate) — dutchie-reviewer label: ship-show - <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1149> — `libs/ui ColumnOrderWidget.tsx` (handleDragEnd wiring) — dutchie-reviewer label: ship-show - <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1150> — `libs/ui DataTable.tsx` (resize+reorder interaction) — dutchie-reviewer label: ship-show - <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1151> — `libs/identity schema.ts` (principal_preferences ON DELETE CASCADE live-test proof; closes   both the gap AND the matching stale-coverage-risk entry on this file — see PR body for why a plain schema.test.ts was not added instead, libs/identity has no such convention) — dutchie-reviewer label: ship-show - <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1152> — `apps/gtm/account-360/api/src/index.ts` (preferencesRoute mount / no-collision-with-/api/preferences test) — dutchie-reviewer label: ship-show - <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1153> — `render-smoke.test.tsx` (new account-table-columns preference fetch coverage) — dutchie-reviewer label: ship-show  All 7 were green + `ship-show` on the first CI pass, no tend pushes needed. Each PR's own body has its red-green-revert proof.  *Skipped as duplicates (Step 3.5):* none — no open `fill test gap` PR referenced the same source PR/file before this run.  *Needs a human — other (unclear):* - `useAccountTableColumnOrder.ts`'s full drag→PUT→reload→restore round trip (PR #875, Medium) — the report itself recommended a unit/live pairing over Playwright (no e2e suite exists), but there's no established harness pattern in this repo for a test that runs both the real hook code and a real live API without a browser. Attempting one risked a vacuous or over-engineered proof — flagging for human judgment on whether new cross-boundary test-harness machinery is worth building. First seen 2026-09-23. - `libs/ui DataTable.tsx`'s groupBy + columnOrder tree-indenting hazard (PR #875, Low) — technically passes this pilot's literal same-source-PR scope rule (PR #875 also touched account-360), but the report entry itself says this "affects neither app   directly" (account-360 never passes groupBy). Judgment call: treated as outside this pilot's deliberately capped blast radius rather than opening a PR for a generic ~25-consumer libs/ui improvement with no account-360 tie-in — flagging the discrepancy rather than silently deviating. First seen 2026-09-23.  *Already covered (report was stale):* none.  Access checks this run: real push access to `GetDutchie/alchemy` and real write access to `GetDutchie/skipped-test-reports` both confirmed live (this run's own lock take + all 7 PRs are the proof).

:bar_chart: *Alchemy (account-360 + pipeline) Test Coverage Audit — last 24h*

Summary: 3 PRs merged touching account-360/pipeline — 1 with full coverage, 2 with gaps

*:red_circle: Gaps (priority)*
- [Medium] feat(implementation): wire Salesforce-status-driven intake/close (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1154|#1154>) — `apps/gtm/account-360/api/src/routes/brief.ts` + `apps/gtm/account-360/api/src/routes/intelligence.ts` — *account-360*: the Drizzle WHERE on `implementationProjects.status` changed from `eq('Active')` to `inArray(['In Progress','Active'])`. The only test is the DB-free `*.sql-fragments.test.ts`. No `*.live.test.ts` runs the POST /brief implementation query or `gatherAccountData`'s implementation branch against real Postgres, and no brief/intelligence live suite exists at all.
- [Medium] chore: sandbox merge integration into develop (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1057|#1057>) — `apps/gtm/account-360/web/src/features/account360/Account360View.tsx` — *account-360*: new `focusLocationId` effect (auto-expands the Locations section, then `scrollIntoView` on `location-<id>`) has no test. `Account360View.test.tsx` was not touched. Only the LocationsPanel highlight is tested.
- [Medium] chore: sandbox merge integration into develop (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1057|#1057>) — `apps/gtm/account-360/web/src/main.tsx` — *account-360*: new `?locationId=` deep-link param passed into `Account360Route` has no test. This is a cross-app (Implementation → account-360) UI flow, so it's e2e-shaped, but account-360 has no e2e spec today (checked `e2e/*.spec.ts`). A unit fallback would be a `MemoryRouter` deep-link hydration test.
- [Low] fix(pipeline): improve kanban scrolling (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1158|#1158>) — `apps/gtm/pipeline/web/src/features/pipeline/PipelineView.tsx` — *pipeline*: layout/CSS-only. The tests only assert class names; real scroll behavior (page scroll, then each stage body scrolls, sticky thead offset) can't be checked in jsdom. That needs e2e, and pipeline has no e2e spec today.

*:warning: Stale coverage risk*
- `apps/gtm/account-360/web/src/features/account360/Account360View.tsx` changed in <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1057|#1057> — test `apps/gtm/account-360/web/src/features/account360/Account360View.test.tsx` last updated in an earlier PR (not in this window). Likely misalignment: the new `focusLocationId` prop and its expand-and-scroll effect aren't exercised.
- `apps/gtm/account-360/web/src/main.tsx` changed in <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1057|#1057> — test "not found" (no route-level test for `Account360Route`'s search-param wiring).
- Caveat: #1057 changed more than 300 files, so its diff and full file list can't be fetched. Its account-360/pipeline files were read from the current tree, and it doesn't touch pipeline. Any `libs/**` files it touched could not be audited.

*:white_check_mark: Coverage added*

- <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1154|#1154> — live + unit (`libs/gtm-db/src/account-read.live.test.ts`, `account-read.test.ts`) — `readImplementationProjectsPageForSystemUse`: keyset cursor, null-accountId exclusion, limit, no FGA check. Alchemy (account-360) test gap fill — 2026-09-24  Source report: <https://getdutchie.slack.com/archives/C0C0TFZNUR2/p1790247871619359> (+ continuation <https://getdutchie.slack.com/archives/C0C0TFZNUR2/p1790247871639839>)  <!subteam^S021R2MD7QQ> — new PRs and/or gaps needing a human below  *PRs opened (2, both against `develop`, both test-file-only):* - <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1160> — `apps/gtm/account-360/api/src/routes/brief.ts` + `intelligence.ts` (live-Postgres coverage for the implementation active-status filter, PR #1154) — dutchie-reviewer label: ship-show - <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1161> — `Account360View.tsx` (`focusLocationId` deep-link expand+scroll effect, PR #1057) — dutchie-reviewer label: ship-show (first push failed typecheck on a test-fixture-type mismatch; fixed and green on the second pass — see PR body)  Both PRs' own bodies have their red-green-revert proof.  *Skipped as duplicates (Step 3.5):* none — no open `fill test gap` PR referenced the same source PR/file before this run.  *Needs a human — production change required (blocks this process from closing the gap on its own):* - `apps/gtm/account-360/web/src/main.tsx`'s `?locationId=` deep-link param wiring into `Account360Route` (PR #1057, Medium) — `Account360Route` is a non-exported closure inside `main.tsx`, and `main.tsx`'s module top level runs a real `ReactDOM.createRoot(...).render(...)` side effect on import, so there's no way to unit-test this one line of plumbing via `MemoryRouter` without either exporting the route (a production-code change) or triggering that side effect in a test. The actual downstream behavior is now covered by PR #1161 above — only the `searchParams.get('locationId')` → prop hand-off inside `main.tsx` itself remains untested. First seen 2026-09-24.  *Needs a human — other (unclear / out-of-scope-for-pilot):* - `apps/gtm/pipeline/web/src/features/pipeline/PipelineView.tsx` scrolling behavior (PR #1158, Low) — out of this pilot's account-360-only scope (pipeline app); also flagged by the report itself as needing an e2e suite pipeline doesn't have. First seen 2026-09-24.  *Already covered (report was stale):* none.
